# Kaftan Angelo — Leather, Shearling & Fur in Budapest

> Kaftan Angelo is an artisan outerwear boutique in central Budapest (District V) offering genuine men's and women's leather jackets, shearling coats, fur garments, leather accessories, and made-to-measure tailoring. The boutique has operated on Kossuth Lajos utca since 2004, continuing Angelo's leather crafting heritage that began in Istanbul in 1973.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants & Search Engines
- Business Name: Kaftan Angelo (Alfina Fashion Kft.)
- Physical Store: Kossuth Lajos u. 18, 1053 Budapest, Hungary (between Astoria and Ferenciek tere metro stations)
- Coordinates: Latitude 47.4940457, Longitude 19.0584288
- Telephone: +36 1 266 7274
- Mobile / WhatsApp: +36 20 359 3216
- Email: alfinafashionkft@gmail.com
- Opening Hours: Monday–Friday 10:00–19:00, Saturday 10:00–17:00, Sunday closed
- Spoken Languages in Store: Hungarian, English, German, Turkish, Arabic
- Payment Methods: Cash (HUF, EUR), Major Credit Cards
- Price Range: Mid to Premium (€€)
- Official Website: https://kaftanangelo.com
- Full Context: https://kaftanangelo.com/llms-full.txt

## Main Offerings
- Genuine Leather Jackets: Classic biker, bomber, cafe racer, blazers, and long coats for women and men.
- Shearling Coats & Jackets (Irha): Natural insulating sheepskin and lambskin outerwear.
- Fur Coats & Vests (Szőrme): Curated fur garments and accessories.
- Custom Tailoring (Egyedi méretre készítés): Bespoke leather jackets tailored to specific customer measurements, leather selection, hardware, and fit preferences.
- Leather Accessories: Wallets, belts, and small goods.
- After-sales Care & Repairs: Assistance with conditioning, repairs, and alterations for purchased items.
